title: Members
intro: Every account with status, vehicles and activity. E-mail addresses are masked.
intro_pii: Every account with status, vehicles and activity. E-mail addresses are masked; the member's profile shows the full address on a click, and that is logged.
caption: Members, newest first
empty_body: As soon as someone signs up in the app, the account shows here.

bulk.restrict_body: Each member gets a decision of their own with this statement, in the app and by e-mail, and may appeal.
bulk.revoke_sessions_body: Every device and browser is signed out. The members get a security notice.
bulk.export_body: After approval each member's data export (ZIP) is built. You can download it for 24 hours.
bulk.delete_body: After approval the accounts are deactivated at once and deleted for good after 30 days. The members are mailed.

list_export.title: Export the list with e-mail addresses
list_export.body: This is an export of personal data (:count members with the current filters). A second team member has to approve; then you download the file under Alerts.
list_export.caption: Needs approval

flash.bulk_partial: Bulk action done, but not for every member. The list shows where it failed.
flash.restricted: Restriction in force. The member was told.
flash.password_change_forced: The member has to set a new password the next time they open the app.
flash.email_changed: E-mail address changed. Both addresses were told.
flash.not_possible: That is not possible for this account right now.

record.error: The member could not be loaded
record.tab_error: This section could not be loaded
record.reveal_failed: The address could not be loaded.

vehicles.caption: The member's vehicles
vehicles.title: Vehicle
vehicles.empty_body: As soon as the member adds a vehicle, it shows here.

security.sign_ins_note: Date and time only, no IP addresses and no device fingerprints.

messages.note: Counts only. No message, no conversation partner, no preview. Opening this section was logged.
messages.forbidden: You do not have permission for the message metadata.

audit.caption: Audit events about this member
audit.empty: No event about this member yet.
audit.forbidden: You do not have permission for the audit log.

privacy.deletion_requested: Requested on :date, deleted for good by :until at the latest.

edit.title: Edit profile
edit.body: The member sees changes at once. A new username frees the old one.
edit.never_password: You never see or set passwords here. Use the reset code instead.

restrict.title: Restrict or suspend :name
restrict.body: A decision under Art. 17 DSA: the member reads the statement in the app and by e-mail and may appeal.

lift.title: Lift :measure
lift.body: A new decision reverses the old one. The member is told.

reset_link.title: Send reset code
reset_link.body: The member gets the usual e-mail with the reset code. You never see or set a password.

force_password.title: Force a password change
force_password.body: The member has to set a new password the next time they open the app; until then every session is locked.

revoke_sessions.title: End all sessions
revoke_sessions.body: Every device, browser and push registration is signed out. The member gets a security notice.

reset_2fa.title: Reset two-factor sign-in
reset_2fa.body: After approval the member signs in with the password alone and can set up 2FA again. They are mailed.

export.title: Export the member's data
export.body: After approval the data export (ZIP) is built. Only you can download it for 24 hours, under Privacy.

delete.title: Delete account :name
delete.body: After approval the account is deactivated at once and deleted for good after 30 days. The member is mailed.

email.title: Change e-mail address
email.body: Only after an identity check, for example when the old mailbox is lost. Both addresses are told.
email.identity_required: Confirm that you checked the identity.

view_as.title: View as :name
view_as.body: Opens the app in a new tab as the member sees it, read-only and without messages. Ends after :minutes minutes.
view_as.reason_hint: Why you need the view, 10–1,000 characters. Logged.
view_as.read_only: Writing, messages and push are blocked in this view.
view_as.running: Your view as the member runs until :until.
view_as.failed: The view could not be started.
view_as.popup_blocked: Your browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups for the admin and try again.
